batting.name: V Sehwag
batting.dismissal: c CA Pujara b JD Unadkat

batting.name: UBT Chand
batting.dismissal: c R Vinay Kumar b JD Unadkat

batting.name: KM Jadhav
batting.dismissal: c R Vinay Kumar b JD Unadkat

balls.text: oh no, what's happened here, run-out for 99! it's a sad way to end this, it was fuller on the off stump and he cracks it through to deep point, there's a single to the fielder, he had to come back for the second and the throw's very close to the stumps, easily run-out
and it was very full and smoked over the bowler's head, six more runs! what batting, what superb batting this, from 50 to 44 to 98 off 57!
and now he's smashed it over long-on for a six! that's some treatment given to the bowling! it was on length yet again and he was hit over the long-on, the fielder could have got close
this is T20 cricket but that's a classic cover drive that's beaten the in-fielder and then the out-fielder at extra-cover for a four!
and now he slaps it over mid-wicket for a four, it was on a length and that's easy pickings for a very good batsman who is very well set
fuller outside the off stump and crashed it away to wide long-off for a couple, Warner runs from long-off but cannot stop the second
slower, shorter and pulled away to the deep square-leg for a single
and he's spanked it down to long-off, it came rather hard at the fielder and needed to quickly get into action to field it, single this time
chipped and gets a couple, he was looking to hit it over the off side but this time chops a little and runs to deep extra-cover
reverse swept for four, the third-man was brought inside the circle, he bowls a yorker-length and ABD reverses it, four more!
down the leg side and that seems to have hit his foot, he was looking to leave and it hits his boot, rolls over and the ump calls it a dead ball for not offering a shot
this is easy for the batsman, he immediately walks across to the off stump, the bowler slows it down, does it matter? no! he easily rocks to the off side and pulls it over to the fine-leg for a four
whoa, six more, he's bowling them on a length and the batsman is swinging it away, this time he connects and he's got himself six more here!
and now a mistimed shot to the extra-cover area for a four, it was outside the off stump and he gets a bottom edge of the bat and still runs away
and that's smoked over the long-on for a six now! Kohli this time, a free swing of the bat that's gone all the way over the fence to a length ball from Yadav
walks across and pulls it to the leg side for a single
this is what ABD does, he was looking to get across the off stump and almost fooled the bowler into bowling outside the off stump, slower too but he punches it over the extra-cover region for a six!
slows it down, pitches it right up to the bat and he wants to flick it over the in-field, gets it only to long-on for a single
outside the off stump and fuller too, easily drilled through to the deep covers for a single
edged for a four! lucky boundary but that's how it is tonight, it was shorter in length and he was looking to pull it away, gets an outside edge and it rushes through the slips for a four
very full on the pads and that's driven down the ground for a couple of runs
short of length and gracefully pull away through to wide long-on for a four, not the quickest innings from him but has done well to stay there that long after a run of poor form
and again, the first one was a full-toss but this time Morkel bowls it slightly shorter and he can only tap it to long-on for a single

and that's deposited over the fine-leg for a six! that's what he's been trying since he started out tonight, goes over to the off side and scoops it over the fine-leg fielder, a top-edge and that's gone all the way

and again, he was trying to walk across outside the off stump to deposit it over the fence, the ball just does not come on, beats his stroke and it falls just short of mid-wicket where Sehwag makes some effort, they get a single
full-toss and flicked away to deep square-leg for a single
that's a good shot, was a slower one, or probably it just did not come on, Kohli was quick into his shot and then he checks it and pulls it to backward square-leg for a couple
aah, wants to take on the inexperienced Kaul but it is very full and that slog shot has to be quickly put back into the closet, tapped to the leg side for a single
wants to launch it away but gets a bit of an inside edge to long-on for a single
slows it considerably and it's on the off stump and can only tap it to the off side for a single

and there you go, that's the first unorthodox shot of the night, or in case of ABD and T20 cricket, a normal one, goes outside the off and tries to scoop it over the fine-leg region, Pathan follows him and the shot goes straight to Sehwag at fine-leg
fuller on the off stump, drives it to long-on for a single
fuller from IP and he's cracked it, hit very hard but straight to the fielder at extra-cover
superb shot! short of length and he pulls it over the mid-wicket fielder for a four, that was exactly the shot that had almost got him caught, he learns from it and smashes it higher this time
slapped but straight to the extra-cover fielder, was on a length and he was looking to get it on either side of that fielder
short of length from Pathan but the ball does not come on and he can only cut it to the off side for a single
shorter in length yet again and cut away to deep point for a single
shorter delivery but on the off stump and keeps low, hits back to the bowler
on his pads and tapped down to long-on for a single
shorter in length and on the middle stump, tucked away to square-leg and the bowlers runs across to field that, Kohli wanted the second but ABD isn't quick enough

very full and that's cracked back to the bowler, who's claiming the catch but Henriques is not sure! the third ump has been called for here, with the bowler seeming quite confident. That's gone straight in and was a fair distance away from the ground, the batsman probably didn't see it
shorter in length and tapped back to mid-off
fuller on the leg stump and he pushes it to wide long-on for a couple of runs, a very-well couple
short of length and pushed to the leg side for a single
advances down the track and slaps it down the ground, gone pretty straight too and they come back for the second by which time MJ dives to his left and parries it to the long-on fielder
short of length and pushed back to the bowler
on his pads and that's flicked away to the leg side, bounces just in front of square-leg where Sehwag's hit on his knee and they are off for one
was looking to swing it across the line, misses, and hits his pads
tries to give himself some room and he bowls it shorter, pushed down to long-on for a single
down the leg side and he was looking to sweep it away, misses but called a wide
down the track and that's pushed on his pads tapped to the leg side for a single
cuts it again but does not pierce the gap, through to short cover
goes down the track and drills it back to the bowler
shorter in length and he wants to cut it, hits it slightly straighter this time
fuller on the off stump and driven to the off side
fuller outside the off stump and he drives it to Warner in the covers within the circle
leading edge that flies to long-off for a single, was looking to flick it away to the leg side
goes down the track and makes it a half volley, drills it through to deep point where Chand runs across to his left and prevents a second
short of length outside the off stump and he punches it through to deep cover for a single, Chand misfields but the batsmen have taken the first run too slowly
slower ball outside the off and cuts it hard through point for a single
this is fuller and he wants to cut it away, mistimes it and it rolls over to backward point
shorter in length and that's cut through deep cover for a four, a very good shot that, on a slowish track
fuller in length and he drives it down to long-off for a single
pitches it up to the bat and Kohli still goes back to cut it, to the left of Pathan at deep cover and he runs across to stop it
fullish in length and on the leg stump line, he gets back and pushes it down to long-on for a single
slower and shorter and cut away to the deep cover region for a single
tries to change his line to closer to the stumps, it's gone too far down now and called a wide
getting them too easily here now, pushed to the covers and away for one
continues that off stump line and Kohli easily opens the face of the bat and pushes it to the point region, there's bit of a misfiled and they are through for one
opens the face of the bat and guides it through to third-man for a single
short of length on the off stump, pushed to the off side for a single
edged through the vacant slips region and runs away through to the third-man fence for a four, it was half an edge and probably some part of that shot was deliberate
fuller from the spinner and driven down to long-off for a single
shorter in length and cuts it hard, only to mistime it to Ben Rohrer's right at point
straighter, on the middle stump and tapped to the off side
well played, he was quick on his feet and went back immediately on seeing it slightly shorter in length, cuts it through backward point
on the middle stump and not too much turn, tapped to the off side for a single
slows it down, slightly shorter and he was looking to cut it, goes to backward point
poor delivery, on his pads, fuller as well and he can only flick it away to the deep square-leg for a single
outside the off stump and defended it to the off side
on the off stump and tapped to the off side for a single

dropped, second chance for Kohli! short of length and he was looking to pull it, but that wasn't not too quick I thought, comes off high of the bat and Sehwag drops it to his right, may be it's his night
gets his length right, outside the off stump and he manages to tap it to the off side for a single
poor delivery, that was a full-toss on the off stump and tapped hard into the ground and then over the fielder at extra cover for a four
wow, grace, class and four, slightly fuller on his pads and that's easily caressed through wide mid-on for a four
on the middle stump and tucked away to deep square-leg for a single, wanted a second, does not go for it
inside edged and this almost goes to the fence, the ball come on slower than he expected and gets the toe, goes to the fine, fine-leg area where Nadeem slides and stops it
on a good length and swinging away from the middle stump, defended it to mid-on
shorter in length but more on his pads and easily tapped away to the wide mid-on fielder for a single
ooh, shorter in length outside the off stump and that's swung away from the bat, beats the outside edge and through to the keeper

and again, but does not successful, bowled! it's been a surprising innings from Pujara, almost as if he had taken over the role of hitting from Gayle, was giving the bowler the charge again but the ball beats the bat, goes between the willow and pad and timber!
and for the third time, he looks to hit it hard, he goes down and spanks it away, straight-smashed for a four
and now he wants to go down the track to one that's outside the off stump, swinging away and he can only cut it away to the point fielder
bludgeoned but straight to the extra-cover fielder, MJ, it was on the off and swinging away, fuller too and he gave it his all, to the fielder
swinging away from the batsman, pulls his length back this time and guided it through to third-man for a single
on the off stump and drives it through the covers for a four, fuller from the new bowler and easily pushed in the gap
lot of bottom hand in that one, it was fuller on the middle stump and he's almost muscled it through mid-wicket for a four
shorter in length, outside the off stump and he wants to cut it hard, gets it straight to the backward point fielder
down the leg-side, swinging down yet again and it's way down for a wide
outside the off stump and he was looking to go down the track, drives it but to the short cover
shorter in length, the same line and length that Gayle has used to tap it back to the fence for four, Pujara plays the same shot but it goes as far as the mid-on, running in
shorter in length outside the off stump and defended to the off side
that's swung quite a lot back into the batsman but it's started on the middle stump and swinging down the leg side, flicked away to fine-leg for a couple
bit wide outside the off stump, some more bounce for Morne and Kohli has no business going after it, lets it go through to the keeper
short of length outside the off stump but not to much bounce on it, defended on the off side
on his pads and that's a lot of flair and style and tapped through the mid-wicket area for a four
yorker length and Kohli is barely able to dig it out to the leg side
edged and...and for the second time I would have said, gone! this time, it 's a no-ball from Morne! Good length ball that took Kohli's edge!
shorter in length and close to the batsman, he opens the face of the bat and guides it through to third-man for a single
edged and...well, should have been gone! but the captain, the new captain has the slip in the third slip area and it sneaks through the first for a four!

bowled him, gone, inside edged! it was outside the off stump and shorter in length, he was looking to pull it away but what only happens is that he gets a thick inside edge that rolls back to the stumps
shorter in length and Gayle defends it back to the bowler, not straight to him, slightly to his left and would you believe it, it's gone, whooshed away, four!
wide outside the off stump, opens the face of the bat and guides it through to third-man for a single
shorter in length this time and wants to tap it through the off side, off the back foot, does not find the gap, goes straight to the point fielder
and full enough to drive it to mid-off yet again, this nips back ever so slightly back into the batsman who covers the movement well
fuller on the off stump and swings back into the right-hander, who defends it to the off side off the front foot
fuller from Morne and slightly outside the off stump, he lets it go through to the keeper yet again, not taking any chances here this early
shorter in length and on the off stump, he was looking to play it off the back foot, defends it to the off side
short of length and closer to the body, tapped back to the bowler
and again, this is slightly fuller but outside the off stump and he lets them go through to the keeper again
length ball and outside the off stump, wide enough to crack it through point but he looks to leave them quite often in the early stage
taps it down the ground for a single, opens the face of the bat and gets Gayle on strike
slower one and he's been banged back for a four through long-on which means that a fighting Delhi have lost by only four runs
aww, game over, Unadkat bowls a yorker that Morne misses, it's as perfect a ball that you can ball in situation, he was swinging it there and is bowled
fuller outside the off stump and all he can do is to dig it out and play it away to the deep covers for a single
over the stumps, full-toss and that's been carved to the fine-leg for a four, the fielder was up inside the circle and was able to find the gap!
full-toss and that's drilled straight down to Kohli at long-on, single brings IP back on strike
fuller and that's banged it down to straight boundary for a four! we have a match on!

wow, what a shot to end the over, what a shot to keep Delhi in the game, it was bowled right in the slot for Pathan to hit it straight and he does exactly that, smashes it to over long-off for a maximum
tonked away over the deep square-leg for a six! it was a length ball and that's hit off the middle of the bat and goes away!
...not that Pathan did much about it, it was outside the off stump, fuller and he gets no bat on it

up and over and that's hit hard to the off side, they wanted a single but Morkel sends him back...why? Because it's called a no-ball and it's a Free-Hit being given, Morkel wanted Pathan to take strike...
shorter in length and he was looking to pull it away, this time it goes to short fine-leg where Pujara has a shy at the stumps, misses with Pathan outside the crease
length ball and IP was giving himself room, wanted to hit it out but it was on the middle stump line, no room to swing his arm
fuller length ball on the middle stump, he was looking to given him room and hit it over the off side, just gets some bat on it and rolls over to the off side
bouncer down the leg side and he lets it go, wide called by the umpire
full-pitcher outside the off stump and drilled through the covers for a couple of runs, the throw comes in but there's no-one backing up and it runs away for an overthrow
good delivery, a perfect yorker, except that it did not get a wicket, inside edged to the fine-leg for a four

poor effort at the deep mid-wicket and it rolls over for a four, slower ball and it was pulled over to the fielder, Henriques could have gone for the catch, instead he waits on it and the ball eludes him
full-toss and wide outside the off, bit of swing there as well and he can get only the bottom of the bat
slower one but he misses that length, bowls very full and that's hit to straightish long-on for a four
full-toss from round the stumps and it's tapped to mid-off, needed to beat that fielder there
outside edge and almost carries to the keeper, well stopped by ABD, was looking to guide it down very fine
bouncer and he goes under it, was a slower one too and it almost did not come on to him
short of length and that's tucked away to the leg side for a single

and now he's gone too, VK's taking them all at long-on, short of length, angling away, he was looking to spank it over the long-on fielder but gets the bottom of the bat and it carries through to the fielder
and this goes behind the keeper for a couple of runs, slower one outside the off stump and he wants to cut hard, gets an under edge and runs away, third-man gets across to the stop it

gone, caught, that's another one biting the dust! it was a slower one and he had no option but to get it over the field, over for a six, it just goes very high and VK takes a reasonably comfortable catch!
shorter in length and cut away but no timing on it, gets it away for a single
on his pads and he goes down but can only tuck it away to deep mid-wicket for a single
wants to slog it away and gets a little too under it, inside edge for a single
on the pads this time and tapped away to the leg side for a single
shorter outside the off stump and tapped to the off side
very short in length and he looks to pull it away, gets a far part of the bat and it's gone straight to the deep square-leg fielder
slower one, he was walking down the pitch and then adjusts his stroke and still slaps it down the ground for a couple of runs, good fielding by Syed Mohammad who runs across from long-on
very close to the stumps, cramping the batsman for room after calling the third-man into the circle, he pushes it into the covers for a single
short of length outside the off stump and he tries to cut it, there was too much pace and bounce on it, wasn't able to time it too well there
slower delivery on the middle stump, read it well too and drives it to long-off for a single
on a good length and punched down to long-off for a single

bowled him, from round the stumps and he gets an inside edge on to the stumps, how many times has this happened tonight? he was looking to guide it through to third-man but does not get it off the part of the bat he wanted.
and finally gets the placement right, outside the off stump and cut through to deep point but fielded well by Pujara
bouncer and this time he ducks under it, in fact it's so high that he does not even go down fully
another appeal for an lbw, he was looking to pull it away, was a shortish delivery, hits his pads and runs away to fine third-man for a four, think height could have been an issue
another slower one, shorter in length too and neatly played it to the off side for a single
looking to pull it away this time, it was a shorter one and it hits his pads, appeal too but was hitting too high and given not-out
slower one and it's on his pads, he's flicked it away to the deep square-leg for a couple of runs
finally gets some bat on it, shorter and wider and cuts it but not in the gap, to the backward point fielder
and beaten again, he was trying to drive it this time and gets the bat nowhere close to it
beaten and goes through to the keeper, it was on the length he was looking to play it through to the third-man
fuller on the middle stump and driven through deep mid-wicket for a single, the fielder was at wide long-on and does well to get there
slows the pace down a lot, he waits, and he waits, and then cuts it hard to the sweeper fielder
adjusts his line and gets it close to the middle stump, opens the face of the bat and through to third-man for a single
round the stumps and does not get his line right, goes down the leg side for a wide
and now he slogs it away, does not time it at all and it's a bit of top edge that lobs up in the gap between long-on and deep square-leg
pitches it right up this time and he drives it to short cover
this was short and gave him time to go back and pull it over the mid-wicket for a four, that's a good shot
looking to go down the track and hits his pad, appeal from Kartik but it was pitching outside the leg stump
on his pads and he looks to tap it to the leg side, hits his pads and rolls away to short fine-leg
shorter in length and this time it's hit hard, cut to the deep covers for a single
slows down the pace and shortens the length, cut to the deep covers for a single
fuller on the off stump and driven to the off side
fullish down the leg side and that's drilled through the leg side, this was an easy two but a clumsy effort from Rampaul lets the ball go through
on the off stump and defended it to the off side
fuller on the middle stump from round the stumps and that's easily tucked to the leg side, another of those deftly played ones that allows him to come back
fuller on the off stump and driven down to long-on for a single
fullish on his pads and that's deftly tucked to deep square-leg, it's not hit hard enough and they can come back for the second
quicker on the off stump and cuts it away to short third-man, not for runs
shorter in length and cut away to the deep covers for a single
shortens his length and bowls on the middle stump that turns away, tapped away to the leg side
fuller outside the off stump and driven to short cover
shorter in length and that's pulled away to fine-leg for a single
fuller and driven to wide long-on, that's placed well for a couple of runs
and that's scooped over the keeper this time for a four, it was a very well placed shot which should have been saved by Unadkat, who can only parry it away and it hits the fence
round the stumps and angled away from the bat, fuller and driven to long-on for a single
another one, poor bowling this, he was looking to dart it there and easily cut away through backward point for a four
shorter in length and outside the off, poor lines these and he's been cut away this time to deep cover for a four
down the leg side as he tries to compensate, goes down for a wide
very short and turns back into the bat but he guides it through short third-man, beats the fielder and gets it away to the fence
shorter in length and tapped down to long-on for a single
slower and shorter and it's cut down to deep cover for a single
on the middle stump from round the stumps, turns away from the batsman and gets a leading edge to short third-man
manages to tuck it away to deep square-leg for a single
shorter but closer to the stumps, he taps it to the close-in leg side fielder
shorter in length outside the off stump, bit of turn back into the bowler and he tries to cut it, inside edge
outside the off stump and fuller from the bowler, he drives it to wide mid-off for a single
bowled him, Warner's gone now! that was slightly quicker in pace and looked like a very straight delivery that the batsman missed, goes through and hits the off stump, captain's back in the dugout
and now Warner's got into the act, it was straighter in line and Warner was looking to play it over all the time, hits it over the bowler's head for a four, was a half volley
cuts hard this time and that's run away to the third-man for a single
shot, that's a shot in anger, it was shorter in length, again without too much pace and he goes through with the pull, in front of square too and gone all the way
not a very quick ball, 121.2 kmph, close to the off stump and that's dabbed to the off side
slows it down well and Warner allows it to hit his bat and taps it to the off side
shorter in length and tapped away to the off side
short of length and he was looking to cut it through the off side, gets it straight to Kohli's left who dives and throws it at the keeper's end, misses, Warner was half the pitch down
outside the off stump, on a length and that's left alone by the batsman
gone, easily taken, slower ball and he was trying to whip it over the mid-on fielder, the slower ball did him in and it spoons up to the mid-on fielder, second man down
length ball outside the off stump and played away to the off side for a single, gets Sehwag back on strike
and the fourth of the over, it was outside the off stump, length ball and he taps it through backward point for the fourth boundary in the over
on his pads and that's whipped through to the deep square-leg for a four, very well timed by the batsman
edged and for a four, that's called throwing your bat at it, Sehwag's done exactly that to one that's outside the off stump and the edge runs through where the slips would have been for a four
opens the face of the bat and runs it down to third-man for a single
up and over for a four! it's a shorter in length and he looks to play it in the V, behind the stumps, over the keeper's head!
has it got the edge this time? the keeper has not appealed at all and the bowler was baying for blood, it's a huge, I repeat, huge edge!
another slower one but pulls his line closer to the stumps, he only pushes it to the off side for a single
another one that's rather slow in pace and Chand has tapped it through the covers this time, gets it in the gap, timed well and runs away to the fence
slows it down considerably and it's on the middle stump, he was looking to unwind before he defends it to the off side
tries to hit him down the ground but does not get it off the middle, runs down to mid-off
on the middle stump and angling away, he defends it off the back foot, to the off side
down the leg-side and does not get any bat on it, wide called

inside edged to the stumps, bowled, one down! it was quite close to the bat, he was looking to run it through to third-man but gets an inside edge and the stumps are rattled, wicket off the first ball for Jaidev and Delhi have lost their first
shorter again from the bowler and this one hurries the pull shot, is only able to get it to short fine-leg for a single
bouncer and he was trying to upper cut that one, the extra bounce defeats him and it goes through to the keeper, there was a bit of an appeal from the bowler
length ball on the off stump and that's driven back to the bowler, fields on his follow-through
straighter this time, on the off stump, defended back to the bowler
chipped over the leg side for a four, that was close to the leg stump line, angling in and he picks it up and hits it over mid-wicket for a four
on his pads and easily tucked away to fine-leg for a four! that was hit very fine and even with the fielder outside the circle, he was never going to get there
and gets tested by another bouncer, which he ducks under rather easily this time, through to the keeper
short of length outside the off stump, he wanted to cut it away, does not get any timing on that one
length ball again and he was looking to walk down, then tucks it to mid-on for a single
on his pads, that's almost nudged away to the fine-leg fence for a four, the fielder was up inside the circle, goes away to the boundary, two in two
up and over, it was on a length and MJ goes through with the shot, hits it over mid-on for a four, excellent shot that!
on his pads and that's tucked away to the leg side, to the short mid-wicket fielder
and again, Sehwag's been hit for the second time, this time it's on his grill! wow, short of length delivery and he ducks right into it, what's happening here?
bouncer and that's hit Sehwag's shoulder, he was ducking under it and misjudges the bounce
fuller and on the off stump and Sehwag likes throwing his bat at it, not exactly that flaying shot but tapped down straight for a four
and that's tucked to the leg side for a couple of runs, trying to cramp Sehwag for room here
shorter in length this time and he has the width to open the face of the bat and guide it to third-man for a single
short of length on the off stump, patted to the off side, to the fielder
